_note: Family-specific text and settings for the whole presentation. Edit freely; every scene reads from here.

welcome._note: Page 1, A Golden Beginning: the screen on the projector while guests arrive. 'title' is shown one line per entry. 'begin' starts the celebration (music on, automatic playback).
title: Fifty Years.
A Thousand Memories.
One Beautiful Life.
welcome.intro: Celebrating the Beautiful Journey of Buvaneswari
welcome.supporting: 50 Years of Love, Strength & Beautiful Memories

reveal._note: Page 2, Happy 50th Birthday. 'photo' is Amma's portrait (an id from data/photo_inventory.json): Age 1 to 50/46.1.jpg, the photograph the family chose to replace the earlier one.
reveal.message: Fifty years of you. A lifetime of us, loving you back.
reveal.photoAlt: Amma, M. Buvaneswari, smiling in a pink and orange silk saree, holding a bouquet of roses

videos._note: The family's own films. Their originals are in VIDEOS/ (never changed); 'npm run build:films' prepares the browser-ready copies in assets/videos/family/ that 'src' points to. storyFilm plays after Happy 50th Birthday; ageFilm and lifeJourney after the family's video wishes, before the cake. 'title' + 'titleAccent' (shown in gold) and 'lede' are the words beside each film. A film whose file is missing is left out. 'memories' is an id in data/photo_inventory.json → films.

storyFilm.title: Age 1 to 5
storyFilm.lede: The story film the family made for her.

ageFilm.title: Age 1 to 50
ageFilm.lede: Fifty years in the family's real photographs.

lifeJourney.title: Her Life
lifeJourney.lede: Her life journey in photographs, from the family.

memories.title: Our Memories, Together
memories.description: A film of her photographs, made by the family.

cake._note: The cake celebration, after the family's video wishes and before A Final Gift of Love. It moves on by itself after 'holdSeconds' in the automatic presentation.
cake.headline: Happy Birthday, Amma
cake.message: Here's to fifty beautiful years, and to every celebration still to come.

finale._note: The last page, A Final Gift of Love. The family's approved closing words.
finale.headline: Happy 50th Birthday, Amma!
finale.subline: 50 Years of Beautiful Memories. A Lifetime of Love. Countless Reasons to Celebrate You.
finale.message: We may never be able to give back everything you have given us, but we will spend our lives making sure you always feel how deeply you are loved.

music._note: Gentle instrumental background music. It starts only when the host presses Begin the Celebration (or the music button / M), stays low, fades out while a video plays and returns afterwards. To change the track, put an MP3 in assets/audio/ and set 'src', 'title' and 'credit'.
